description: Join a relay on this node's list, by its row's public key (key), by email; add it first (contact.add). With an email it asks the relay to mail a link (link, or else this node's own join page) carrying a code: {ok, url}. With that code it takes the seat, puts the relay on the list and connects to it: {ok, url, label}, 201 for a new seat and 200 for an email change on a seat already held. Refused 400 without a relay row or with neither email nor code, 503 with no router to join with, the relay's own refusal under its status, and 502 when it does not answer.
